title: MobileNet and EfficientNet

paper.title: MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications

related.title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks

paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement MobileNet and EfficientNet: compare depthwise separable convolutions and compound scaling on CIFAR-100 with explicit FLOP accounting. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cifar100; required output: [N,3,32,32] -> [N,100] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Report multiply-add convention and measured latency separately from FLOPs. Required ablation: Replace depthwise separable blocks by dense convolutions at matched output shapes. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
